sections.heading: Who I am
paragraphs: Business Analytics student @ NUS specialising in Machine Learning-based Analytics.
With data, I like that the same numbers can tell you something completely different
once you find another way to look at them. That's what interests me about machine
learning: uncovering something unexpected, then figuring out how to show it so
someone else can have that "oh, now I see it" moment too.
quote: Psst... I'm usually listening to music or getting lost in the,
latest tech developments -- quantum chips, gaming hardware, phones,
Linux, Raspberry Pis... whatever catches my attention that day.
